```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '7.4'

    - name: Install Composer dependencies
      run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

    - name: Run PHPUnit tests
      run: vendor/bin/phpunit

    - name: Run Behat tests
      run: vendor/bin/behat features/prompt.feature

    - name: Check for code quality
      run: vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=PSR2 .

    - name: Check for security vulnerabilities
      run: vendor/bin/security-checker security:check

    - name: Check for backward compatibility
      run: |
        git diff HEAD^ HEAD -- php/WP_CLI/Dispatcher/Subcommand.php | grep -q "get_arg_description()" && echo "Backward compatibility check passed" || echo "Backward compatibility check failed"

    - name: Check for minimal changes
      run: |
        git diff --shortstat HEAD^ HEAD | grep -q "2 files changed" && echo "Minimal changes check passed" || echo "Minimal changes check failed"
```
